item.title: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds – Year Two Showcase Wrap Up!
item.description:
Thank you all for an incredible Year One of Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds! But we’re just getting started. We are pleased to announce that Year Two will be going live November 3, 2026.

Today during the Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds World Championship Finals, we presented the Year Two Showcase, which provided a detailed look into what’s to come: from a new gameplay mode to gameplay updates, from more free characters to bonus content, and to all-new premium guest DLC Packs, there’s a lot more to look forward to in Year Two!

Major Day One Updates

  • Duel Mode - Battle your way to the finish line with the thrilling, all-new 1v1 Duel Mode. In Duel Mode, players race against a single opponent where item tactics and the new Duel Boost mechanic play critical roles in overcoming the competition. The game-changing Duel Boost gauge is filled over time – and with frequent item usage and – can be used strategically to gain large bursts of speed throughout the race.

With the ability to see your opponents’ items, gadgets, and race position, playing offense and defense with your own items is key to gaining – and keeping – the advantage.

  • Duel Mode can be played in the following ways:

    • Rival Duel - Offline matches against CPU Rivals (Free and owned Paid DLC characters). Defeat all Rivals to earn rewards, including a special Machine.

    • Duel Match (Free Match) - Online races against random player opponents in a free matchmaking environment.

    • Duel Match (Best-of-10) - Limited-Time online events with special rules, Duel Class ranks, and Medal rewards for competitive play.

    • Friend Match - Online races against friends with customizable Race Rules, Items, and CrossWorlds.

  • Gadget System Upgrade – A new gadget plate, the Grand Master Plate, has been introduced, which adds a 7th “Super Slot” for 1-slot gadgets. Any 1-slot gadget that’s placed into the Super Slot will have its boosted effect even more amplified, opening up more combinations and possibilities for creative gadget builds.

In addition, 15 new gadgets will be added on Day One, with more to come with future content updates.

  • Post-Launch Characters as CPU Racers – Both Free characters and Paid DLC characters will now show up as CPU opponents in both online and offline modes.

  • Year Two Free Characters – Year Two brings new racers and machines being added to the already expansive roster. The first three free characters were announced as part of the Year Two showcase:

    • Bayonetta – Fan-favorite Bayonetta graces CrossWorlds with her presence. Bayonetta will be available on November 3, 2026 as a character to be unlocked via Rival Duel matches.

    • McLaren Racing – A Speed-type machine modeled after the real racing car, driven by Sonic in McLaren's Papaya and Anthracite livery. Available later in November 2026.

    • Aigis – A member of the Specialized Extracurricular Execution Squad and a transfer student at Gekkoukan High, Aigis enters the race with her Palladion Dressy, an Acceleration-type machine, in early 2027.

    • Each free character drop will be followed by a uniquely themed, Limited Time Event Festival, which offers bonus content rewards that players can earn by participating in and winning Festival races.

    • All new Festivals will now be active for ten days straight, while past fan-favorite Festivals will return for shorter timeframes.

Season Pass Two brings an all-new roadmap of six premium DLC Packs, featuring even more exciting collaborations with iconic entertainment franchises. DLCs include:

  • DLC Pack #1 - Godzilla Pack - Releasing November 3, 2026

    • Course: Godzilla Escape

    • Machines: Godzilla Cruiser, King Ghidorah Coupe, Mothra Surf

    • Additional Jukebox music tracks

    • Additional sounds

  • DLC Pack #2 - EVANGELION Pack - Releasing January 2027

    • Course: Tokyo-III

    • Racers: Rei Ayanami, Asuka Shikinami Langley

    • Machines: EVA-01 (TEST TYPE), EVA-00 (PROTO TYPE), EVA-02 (PRODUCTION MODEL)

    • Additional Jukebox music tracks

    • Additional character emotes

    • Additional sounds

  • DLC Pack #3 - Virtual Sanrio Puroland Pack - Releasing Q2 2027

    • Course*: Virtual Sanrio Puroland

    • Racers: Hello Kitty, Kuromi

    • Machines**: Hello Kitty Apple Kart, Kuromi Charming Cruiser

    • Additional Jukebox music tracks

    • Additional character emotes

    • Additional sounds

  • DLC Pack #4 - SEGALAND Pack - Releasing Q3 2027

    • Course: SEGALAND

    • Machines: After Burner, OutRun, Super Megalo

    • Additional Jukebox music tracks

    • Additional sounds

  • DLC Pack #5 - Midgar Pack (Working Title) - Releasing Q3 2027

    • 1 Course

    • 2 Racers

    • 1 Machine

    • Additional Jukebox music tracks

    • Additional character emotes

    • Additional sounds

  • DLC Pack #6 - Reload Revival Royal Pack from the Persona Series - Releasing Q4 2027

    • 1 Course

    • 2 Racers

    • 2 Machines

    • Additional Jukebox music tracks

    • Additional character emotes

    • Additional sounds

  • Bonus Season Pass Two Content #1 – SEGA Controllers Decal Pack – Available starting October 9, 2026

    • Decals: GENESIS Controller, SEGA SATURN Controller, Dreamcast Controller, Dreamcast Visual Memory Unit

  • Bonus Season Pass Two Content #2 – SEGA Consoles Pack – Available starting November 3, 2026

    • Machines: Genesis Tower US, SegaSaturn JP, Dreamcast EU

  • Bonus Season Pass One + Two Content – Super Shadow – Available starting November 3, 2026 (must own both Season Pass One and Season Pass Two)

    • Racer: Super Shadow

    • Machine: Super Dark Flare

But that’s not all! Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds game products will see a number of changes for both the dedicated players looking to expand their experience and brand-new players looking to enter the race:

  • Standard Edition & Digital Deluxe Edition PRICE DROP – Effective immediately, the Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds Standard Edition price will permanently be reduced from $69.99 USD down to $39.99 USD and the Digital Deluxe Edition from $89.99 down to $59.99 USD.

  • Season Pass Two – The new Season Pass Two can be purchased now for $29.99 USD for all platforms where Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds is available. It also contains both the SEGA Controllers Decal Pack (available starting October 9, 2026) and the SEGA Consoles Pack (available starting November 3, 2026). The Super Shadow racer and machine will also be granted as bonus content for owners of both Season Pass One and Season Pass Two.

  • Year Two Digital Deluxe Edition – The Year Two Digital Deluxe Edition can be purchased now for $59.99 USD for all platforms where Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds is available. The product includes the Standard Edition of the game and Season Pass Two.

    Current owners of Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds should not purchase this Edition, as they will receive a redundant copy of Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds Standard Edition.

  • Year One Edition (Physical) – The Year One Edition can be purchased for $59.99 USD at select retail stores. This physical product includes the Standard Edition of the game and Season Pass One; it also contains

    • The 35th Anniversary reversible coversheet

    • The 35th Anniversary logo patch

*The Virtual Sanrio Puroland course included in the Virtual Sanrio Puroland Pack is not available in Mirror Mode.

**Machine parts cannot be customized for the Hello Kitty Apple Kart and Kuromi Charming Cruiser machines included in the Virtual Sanrio Puroland Pack.

item.title: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™ – Game Tactics
item.description:
Want to improve your chances of climbing the ranks and becoming an elite racing pilot in the Galactic League?

Fuse Games, the development team behind Star Wars: Galactic Racer™, share some tips about their favorite builds and how to maximize their potential to give you an edge in the competition.

Fuse Games' Creative Director Kieran Crimmins, Game Director Bill Lane, and Design Director Mark Bridges provide insight into their favorite builds and playstyles.

Mark chooses the landspeeder and focuses on a build designed to take out opponents. Bill goes for the skim speeder, a new Star Wars™ vehicle making its debut in Star Wars: Galactic Racer, and opts for a build that relies on strategic use of Abilities. Kieran selects the speeder bike and plans to win races by taking extreme measures...

Watch the full Game Tactics video here.



Which build do you prefer? Do you want to mercilessly takedown rivals like Mark, exploit all of the tech at your disposal like Bill, or fly down the track in a literal blaze of glory like Kieran?

In this runs-based reinvention of racing, the combination of Racer Styles, Abilities, and Parts means that you're sure to find a build that suits you.
